identity.name: CIRCA at Foggy Bottom
identity.notes: The restaurant-issued Foggy Bottom page and its exact linked ChowNow store both identify 2221 I St NW, Washington, DC 20037. Clarendon, Navy Yard, and The Boro have different addresses and are explicitly excluded from the current product boundary.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The official menu legend distinguishes vegetarian, vegan, dairy-free, contains shellfish, contains nuts, gluten sensitive, and can be modified to be gluten sensitive.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Positive contains-shellfish and contains-nuts icons are preserved with direct item evidence. Dairy-free and gluten-sensitive icons are supported dietary claims but are not converted into categorical allergen absence. The black M icon is a modification marker, not a milk declaration.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: CIRCA states that it is not a gluten-free environment and that individual gluten sensitivity varies.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Preserved separately as restaurant-level gluten cross-contact context. It is not converted into blanket product mayContain labels.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: CIRCA asks guests to notify the server of food allergies or dietary restrictions; its gluten-sensitive guide says staff can make recommendations and consider preparation precautions.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is an accommodation statement, not a guarantee that any product is free of an allergen.

evidence.excerpt: The official CIRCA at Foggy Bottom page gives 2221 I St NW, current hours, and live Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, Cocktails and Wine, Beer, Brunch, Whiskey Flights, and Dessert sections with product descriptions and links to location-specific PDFs and ordering.

The current Foggy Bottom-linked Spring 2026 lunch PDF contains 43 food products, a dietary-icon legend, the statement that CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment, and a request to notify the server about allergies or dietary restrictions.
The current Foggy Bottom-linked dinner PDF contains 39 food products and repeats the restaurant's dietary-icon legend, gluten-environment caution, and allergy-notification request.
The current Foggy Bottom-linked Spring 2026 brunch PDF contains 44 food products and the same dietary-icon and gluten-environment disclosures.

The official site's Foggy Bottom order link resolves to ChowNow location 34562 at 2221 I St NW. It exposes 44 distinct current food products after popular-item repeats are consolidated; three utensil and condiment controls are excluded as service modifiers.
The current Foggy Bottom Spring 2026 beverage PDF identifies four mocktails and two nonalcoholic beers. Its cocktails, wines, spirits, and alcoholic beers are outside the POC boundary.
The official map distinguishes Foggy Bottom at 2221 I St NW from Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd, Navy Yard at 99 M Street SE, and The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Drive.

A restaurant-issued Foggy Bottom gluten-sensitive guide explains that modified items differ from standard-menu preparations, says CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment, and asks guests to inform staff of allergies so precautions can be considered. It is preserved as supporting evidence, not an allergen-absence matrix.
